evals.prompt: /appops publish my Nowa project to the web
evals.expected_output: Routes to appops-nowa-expert; plans, asks for an explicit yes before publishing, checks the plan tier, verifies the live page.

evals.prompt: Refactor my Dart repository class to use Riverpod
evals.expected_output: Does not write code; hands off to fsdevops if installed, otherwise says it is developer work.

evals.prompt: How do I do this in Figma?

evals.expected_output: Explains helper-method widgets are opaque; hands a code request to fsdevops to split into widget classes; re-checks on the board.

evals.expected_output: Says Windows desktop is not a documented Nowa cloud target; hands the build to fsdevops (flutter build windows).
